subject: possible to specify only inits for ONLY SOME parameters?

messages.author: e591fcf77457775e
messages.subject: possible to specify only inits for ONLY SOME parameters?
parts:
I'm using rstan. I provide a function that generates inits. 

Stan fails if any parameter's inits aren't specified. Is this a desired behavior? I would think model building might be hastened by being able to specify inits only when needed, defaulting to something sensible...

thx, j

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] possible to specify only inits for ONLY SOME parameters?
parts:
On 8/21/13 2:18 PM, jb5 wrote:
> I'm using rstan. I provide a function that generates inits.
>
> Stan fails if any parameter's inits aren't specified. Is this a desired behavior?

It's not a bug --- it was just easier to build that
way.

> I would think model building might be
> hastened by being able to specify inits only when needed, defaulting to something sensible...

Absolutely. And you're not the only one who's requested
the feature. It's near the top of our to-do list,
but won't get it done for 2.0.

We're also going to add an inits block to the models
so you can do the inits in Stan using Stan's RNGs.

- Bob
